cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Base can't hear our ship's report. Our real assignment must be receiving. Leave the volume alone; I'll change channels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only static. I need the forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's applause. We've been sent to entertain them. Hold the microphone level, please. I'll sing the forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Base just said, 'Stop singing.' Shall I apologize?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, this is rejection training. Tell me firmly that I can't sing another verse. Start again if you sound apologetic.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 directs microphone handling for a new entertainment mission and A5 corrects apologetic refusal into rejection practice after that mission fails.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 static and forecast need cause A3 singing; B4 explicit stop-singing message causes A5 rejection training.

relationship.evidence: B2 has an impending watch and B4 proposes a reasonable apology, grounding the partner in work.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 rebuff and apology proposal to assign a new refusal exercise immediately.

specificity.evidence: A1 ship/base radio and B2 forecast make the communication task legible; B4 quotes the actual response.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 final instruction about apologetic delivery changes how B must perform the new task, rather than merely naming a mission.
